en.Отключить Power Throttling для всех прог: Turn off Power Throttling for all apps
en.Windows перестаёт замедлять фоновые прог: Windows stops slowing down background apps to save energy.
en.Записывает PowerThrottlingOff=1. Игре в: Writes PowerThrottlingOff=1. It does not help a game in the active window: Windows does not slow down the active app. Background apps start using more power. A restart is required. Undo it with a rollback in Lycoris.
en.Lycoris это не рекомендует: игре не помо: Lycoris does not recommend this: it does not help games, and a laptop battery drains faster.
en.Общий системный таймер, как в Windows 10: Global system timer, as in Windows 10
en.Запрос точного таймера одной программой: A precise-timer request from one app affects all apps again.
en.Записывает GlobalTimerResolutionRequests: Writes GlobalTimerResolutionRequests=1 (Windows 11). Games request a precise timer for themselves, so they do not need it. Useful only for old apps that relied on the global timer. A restart is required. Undo it with a rollback in Lycoris.
en.Lycoris это не рекомендует: FPS не растё: Lycoris does not recommend this: FPS does not grow, and the PC uses more energy.
en.Сон S3 вместо Modern Standby: S3 sleep instead of Modern Standby
en.Просит Windows использовать старый режим: Asks Windows to use the old S3 sleep state instead of Modern Standby.
en.Записывает PlatformAoAcOverride=0. Работ: Writes PlatformAoAcOverride=0. Works only when the PC firmware supports S3; many new laptops have no S3. A restart is required. Undo it with a rollback in Lycoris.
en.Lycoris это не рекомендует: ноутбук може: Lycoris does not recommend this: the laptop may stop going to sleep or waking up. If that happens, roll it back.
en.Запретить фоновую работу всем приложения: Deny background activity to all Store apps
en.Политика Windows: приложения из Microsof: Windows policy: Microsoft Store apps do not run in the background.
en.Записывает политику LetAppsRunInBackgrou: Writes the LetAppsRunInBackground=2 policy. The background-activity switches in Settings become unavailable. Undo it with a rollback in Lycoris.
en.Lycoris это не рекомендует: перестанут п: Lycoris does not recommend this: notifications and alarms stop, Phone Link and Xbox stop working.
en.Политика Windows: планировщик пакетов не: Windows policy: the packet scheduler reserves no bandwidth for prioritised traffic.
en.Записывает политику NonBestEffortLimit=0: Writes the NonBestEffortLimit=0 policy. The reserve is used only when an app asks for priority; otherwise the whole bandwidth is available anyway. Undo it with a rollback in Lycoris.
en.Lycoris это не рекомендует: скорость и п: Lycoris does not recommend this: speed and ping do not change.
en.Всплывающие уведомления всех программ пе: Toast notifications from all apps stop appearing.
en.Записывает ToastEnabled=0 для текущего п: Writes ToastEnabled=0 for the current user. A gentler option is Do Not Disturb in Windows: it turns on by itself in games. Undo it with a rollback in Lycoris.
en.Lycoris это не рекомендует: пропадут все: Lycoris does not recommend this: all notifications disappear, including alarms and reminders.
